To see what true community-centered design looks like, check out the work that @seamonwhiteside is doing. 🏗️

The Chamber was honored to welcome SeamonWhiteside's Asheville office with a recent ribbon cutting. They're a regional company focused on helping communities balance social, environmental and economic resilience in everything they design — and at the Chamber, that's a balance we wholeheartedly believe in. We're excited to see how their vision of sustainability can help define the future
